2026-08-31 conversion to real members: all fourteen extern "C" free functions became dScMgBSC_c member functions -- OnYoshiTryEat/OnTurnIntoEgg/OnGroundPounded (vtable slots 18/19/21) and the eleven state handlers (mState indexes the PMF table sBSCStateTable, filled by __sinit_ov006_0213326c). Each was byte-verified with tools/match.py as it converted; the compiler-emitted mangled names in functions[] are those match runs resolved.

2026-09-03 full-boundary consolidation: the original 19-function scene promotion ended at 0x021255f8, but the immediately adjacent unique MG_BS_CARD classInit extends the same original TU through 0x0212568c. The text, data, static-initializer and BSS boundaries all change ownership to dScMgSnowball_c at their next address. The retired MgLuckyStars_Spawn.cpp was therefore a one-function fragment of this class TU, not a separate source boundary.

The 0x270 shared state at scene offset 0x4f38 is now a real dMgBSCSharedState_c member with its measured Dealer_Destruct destructor, so C++ owns that step of reverse-order scene teardown. The 2-by-8 card-position array is Vector2 mCardPos[2] (include/Vector2.h): func_0203d738/NullDestructor_0203d47c are the empty structors of the 2D Fix12 vector whose helper run they sit in (arm9 0x0203d388..0x0203d738), shared by every 8-byte position/velocity array in the minigames. The class name is coined, as Vector3's is; no ROM RTTI names it.

MEASURED CW 1.2 FACTORY WALL: dScMgBSC_c_classInit is allocation plus a fully folded scene construction sequence. The compiler rejects class, global and placement operator-new declarations and supplies no placement-new builtin, so semantic placement construction cannot reproduce the body. The one literal classInit bridge is retained; its allocation size, base construction, vptr transitions, Particle::SysTracker member, typed shared-state construction and card-position array construction all remain explicit and byte-exact.

FOCUSED VERIFY LIMITATION: tools/tubuild.py verify reports 19/20 because objisolate rejects the classInit's R_ARM_ABS32 relocation with addend zero against _ZTV10dScMgBSC_c emitted by the same object. The extracted classInit bytes match individually and all 20 text sections occur in cartridge order; the production linker and full ROM build are the authority for that same-object vtable relocation.

COINED NAMES, the one thing not provable: the state handlers' ROM symbols are address-only (func_ov006_02124a04..), so no recovered spelling exists to confirm or contradict StateDone/StateReturnCards/StateWaitTable/StateTableReaction/StateJudgeCards/StateRevealCards/StateWaitMove/StateMoveCards/StateChooseCard/StateWaitDeal/StateDealCards. The coinage is disclosed here, in include/dScMgBSC_c.h's state-machine comment, and in symbols/actor_renames.tsv's why column; the three event names (OnYoshiTryEat/OnTurnIntoEgg/OnGroundPounded) are legacy recovered names that stand uncontradicted. Table entries 7/8 (StateTableReaction) have no mState writer anywhere in the recovered code -- kept byte-exact, see the source comment.

D3 declarations: Math_Function_0203b14c, Dealer_IsIdle, Dealer_Load, Dealer_Update and Dealer_PlayLose are declared at the definition's own signatures where this TU alone owns the declaration (the first four); Dealer_PlayLose and Dealer_PlayWin keep decl_common.h's void* spellings because redeclaring a C-linkage symbol with different parameter types is an illegal overloading. Sound::PlayBank2_2D, GXS::LoadOBJPltt and ApproachLinear are declared in their RATIFIED_TRUE_NAMES forms with C++ linkage.
